text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, we're here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without any explanation, Epiphaneia brought me along to a shrine that had recently become popular for bringing good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hmm, to be honest, I'm not really sure myself!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Still, I just had a feeling I ought to come here today,
even if I don't really know why.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny said it'd be good too,
and I'm also curious about these blessings!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer!
I'm sure something wonderful is waiting for us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might just be her usual momentum,
but Epiphaneia has been in a bit of a slump lately.
It feels somewhat fateful.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's properly pay our respects—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! They have wooden plaques!
I wanna write on one, I wanna write on one!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm going on ahead—!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, finished!
"Bring the voice of destiny to everyone!"
Yes, this is written well.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah! They're selling charms at the amulet office!
Let's go buy one, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Family safety, passing exams, traffic safety...
There are so many, but if you're buying one, this is the one!
A love charm!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Just making a connection with me
brings happiness that much closer!
Just you wait, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From her forceful conviction, it's clear she's genuinely thinking of everyone else's happiness. That's wonderful, but...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's right, the shrine maiden at the talisman counter told me there's a sacred tree behind the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I heard it's been getting a lot of attention as a spiritual power spot lately! I definitely gotta check it out!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a 500-year-old tree! That was so powerful!
I can totally see why it's a spiritual spot!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Now then, next up is—
choice_data_list: Wait! Let's finish paying our respects first!
Wait! Let's finish paying our respects first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, it'll be night by the time
we visit the shrine. We should probably
fulfill our original purpose soon.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! We came here to pay our respects at the shrine!
Alright, let's go pray!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There was a certain etiquette to this, wasn't there?
Teach me by my side, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap-clap!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, God!
That was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Trainer,
my body suddenly feels so light!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's true! It's like my slump was all just a lie—
so this is what a divine blessing feels like!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I came after all!
Visiting a shrine is actually pretty nice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might all be a coincidence. But,
just maybe—without saying anything tacky,
I simply rejoiced in her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Trainer, my body feels kind of—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I feel like it's heavy!
choice_data_list: Did I get too carried away? Let's head back soon.
Maybe I got a little too carried away? Let's head back soon.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hmm, and here I was hoping to receive some divine blessings!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was plenty of fun!
Let's come again, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made a mental note to have her pray properly
next time so she can actually receive
the gods' blessings.
